marker_policy: For this successor, the production preflight requires the GPU-window marker absent. No tenant override is configured. Any marker present at a later checkpoint fails closed; the declaration path is intentionally nonexistent and is not read while the marker is absent.
command_sha256_binding: Self-hash the exact command file at launch and pass it to the child; it is intentionally not stored in this binding because the command pins this binding SHA.
gate: Existing hash pass verifies exact export digest, captures root keys/arrays and selected membership IDs from version_membership edges before metadata. Only records and edges top-level arrays are accepted; an extra array refuses before pass1. Both root orders supported.
count_units: Logical source records and edges are counted once. Per-pass observations are reported separately and must not be added to logical rows. Per-kind counts include selected_rows, excluded_rows and nonselected_rows; excluded and nonselected are the same unmatched subset and overlap exactly, so do not sum all three. evaluation_object edges are nonselected from the projection but remain global leakage context. Membership row occurrences and unique membership IDs, and selected object rows and unique object digests, are separate measures.

One Job Object sets both ProcessMemoryLimit and JobMemoryLimit to 536870912 bytes (512 MiB), kill-on-close; runner guard binding is also 536870912 bytes, BelowNormal priority, one compute thread, 900 seconds.
